_comment: Pre-existing duplicate SPEC.md changelog version numbers, recorded so the guard blocks NEW duplicates without demanding a historical cleanup. Each entry maps a version to the number of rows currently carrying it. Shrink this file when a duplicate is genuinely reconciled; never grow it to make a build pass.
_comment_text: Changelog rows whose prose is identical under different version numbers. These arise when a hot-prepend conflict is resolved by keeping 'both' rows where one was already a renumbered copy of the other. Each entry lists the versions currently sharing one body. Shrink this map when a pair is genuinely reconciled; never grow it to make a build pass.
